# Vendored browser runtimes

These files are committed so G2 Recall works on GitHub Pages without a CDN or build step.

- `fflate.umd.js`: fflate 0.8.2, MIT License
- `sql-wasm.js` and `sql-wasm.wasm`: sql.js 1.13.0, MIT License

The upstream license texts are available in the corresponding npm packages:

- https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate/blob/master/LICENSE
- https://github.com/sql-js/sql.js/blob/master/LICENSE
